map.按 Unicode 码点反转，中文每个字是一个码点，反转后字序颠倒但字本身不变；: Reversal works on Unicode code points; each Chinese character is one code point, so the character order flips while the characters themselves stay intact. Combining marks (such as tones) may separate from their base character, so normalize before reversing.
